name: Spellbound Armor
description: An empty suit of full plate armor that glows with a faint corona of ghostly light.

abilities.name: Tireless
abilities.description: The Armor can’t be forced to mark Stress. When an effect would cause it to mark Stress, the Armor ignores that part of the effect.

abilities.name: Clatter & Recombobulate
abilities.description: Once per scene when the Armor is defeated, you can spend a Fear to reactivate it. Clear 2 HP and immediately spotlight it.
